summary: @servicetitan/grid preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". At npm install time, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmod+x's the binary, then invokes execFileSync(bun, [math_init.js]) against a sibling file at the tarball root. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (hex-mangled identifiers, rotating string/opcode array under a WV8StW rotator, large constant table) whose content is opaque to Node-based supply-chain scanners because it is executed under the freshly dropped Bun interpreter. The package's stated purpose is a Kendo/React grid wrapper (dist/index.js) and has no need for a second language runtime or a large non-React math bundle. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are present at the tarball root but not listed in package.json "files": ["dist", "src"], meaning the install-time entry points were shipped outside the declared publish manifest. Installing this version causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's machine via the dropped alternate runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
